tokens.name: Name
tokens.enabledGuide: Disabled keys are rejected immediately at authentication.
tokens.limitGuide: Leave empty for no cumulative spend cap. Amounts use up to six decimal places.
tokens.rateLimitRpmGuide: Leave empty to inherit the global fallback. 0 disables the limit for this token; a positive number may exceed the global cap.
tokens.amountGuide: Enter the target balance directly, or accumulate quick steps; the formula result applies when you save. Not below 0.
tokens.modelGroupGuide: The token can only see and call names in this group. Unspecified tokens use Ungrouped.
tokens.deleteMessage: Delete token "{name}"? This cannot be undone.
tokens.bulkDeleteMessage: Delete {count} selected tokens? This cannot be undone.

channel.search: Search by name, URL, or model
channel.name: Name
channel.enabledGuide: Disabled channels are excluded from routing and failover.
channel.goneOnSave: This channel has been deleted and can no longer be saved.
channel.modelGroupGuide: New callable names are added to this group on save. Ungrouped means they are not added automatically.
channel.modelsEmpty: No models yet. Add an ID below, or use “Set models” to fetch them.
channel.addModelIsAlias: This ID is already an alias
channel.syncNotSynced: Not synced yet. Click “Sync models” to fetch the upstream model list.
channel.syncSearchPlaceholder: Search by model name or alias
channel.syncAliasOccupiesSelected: Alias {alias} is already a selected model. Saving would rewrite {occupied} to {owner}. Uncheck {occupied}, or pick a different alias.
channel.syncAliasClaimedTwice: Alias {alias} is assigned to both {first} and {second}.
channel.deleteMessage: Delete channel "{name}"? This cannot be undone.
channel.bulkDeleteMessage: Delete {count} selected channels? This cannot be undone.

pricing.usdGuide: Dollars per 1M tokens, up to six decimal places.
pricing.optionalUsdGuide: Optional. Leave empty to leave this tier uncharged.
pricing.deleteMessage: Remove "{name}" from channel "{channel}"'s model list? Aliases that point to it are removed too.
pricing.bulkDeleteMessage: Remove {count} selected models from the currently visible channel lists? Aliases that point to them are removed too.

models.emptyInventory: No registered models yet. Add them on a channel, then they appear here.
models.catalogError: Could not load the price catalog.
models.unifiedMembersEmpty: No members yet. Check registered models below.
models.unifiedHide: Hide members from the downstream list
models.unifiedHideGuide: When on, members disappear from this group's model list; the unified ID remains. Direct calls to a member still work if it is in the group.
models.unifiedEmpty: No unified models yet. Optional: pick registered models and give them one downstream ID.
models.unifiedDeleteMessage: Delete unified model "{name}"? This cannot be undone.
models.unifiedBulkDeleteMessage: Delete {count} selected unified models? This cannot be undone.
models.groupModelsEmpty: No models in this group yet. Check available models below.
models.groupEmpty: No custom groups yet. Tokens without a group use Ungrouped.
models.groupDefaultHint: Names not listed in another group stay available to Ungrouped.
models.groupDeleteMessage: Delete group "{name}"? This cannot be undone.
models.groupForceDeleteMessage: Group "{name}" still has tokens bound. Force delete will move those tokens back to Ungrouped.
models.groupBulkDeleteMessage: Delete {count} selected groups? This cannot be undone.
models.visibleLead: Read-only preview of what a token in this group sees. Unbound tokens use Ungrouped. Nothing is saved here.
models.visibleEmpty: This group currently lists no models.

settings.fullBody: Log full request and response bodies
settings.fullBodyGuide: When on, subsequent requests store complete conversation bodies in plaintext in SQLite. Use only for troubleshooting, and keep the log body cap below.
settings.maxRequestBytesGuide: Requests larger than this are rejected with 413 immediately. Up to two decimal places.
settings.logBodyMaxBytesGuide: When full_body is on, each request/response body is truncated to this size. Independent of the inbound request limit. Up to two decimal places.
settings.authThrottleMaxGuide: After this many auth failures from one IP in the window, respond 429. 0 disables the limit.
settings.authThrottleWindowGuide: Counting window for auth failures; the count resets after it elapses.
settings.sseReassemblyMaxGuide: Stop the stream if an incomplete upstream frame exceeds this. Up to two decimal places.
settings.retryBackoffMsGuide: Starting wait for exponential backoff when Retry-After is absent.
settings.retryBackoffCapGuide: Maximum exponential wait. Must be at least the base interval.
settings.retryBackoffCapTooSmall: Backoff cap cannot be smaller than the base interval
settings.retryAfterCapGuide: Maximum wait taken from an upstream Retry-After header.
settings.rateLimitRpmGuide: Fallback for tokens without their own limit. 0 disables the global cap. A token may set a higher cap or 0 (unlimited).
settings.catalogSyncedAtGuide: Successful writes of the models.dev cache. Never synced stays empty.
settings.catalogIntervalGuide: 0 means manual only. The process checks about once an hour.
settings.saveSuccess: Settings saved. Changes apply to new inbound requests immediately.

logs.settleSuccess: Charged the log cost and marked settled
logs.settleGuide: Deduct this log's cost from the token balance. Overdraft is allowed.
logs.waiveGuide: Mark this log settled without changing the balance.
logs.bodyBinary: Binary content ({bytes} bytes) is not displayed.

auth.adminKey: Enter the static admin key from the config file. It is stored only in this browser.

validation.usdMin: Enter a dollar amount of {min} or greater

validation.mbMin: Enter an MB amount greater than 0
